zh.title: FAA新規禁止飛機後推時握持飲料杯　影響頭等艙服務時間
zh.summary: FAA新規要求後推時禁止握持飲料杯；優質客艙起飛前服務時間縮短
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）發布新規定，要求飛機在進行後推作業期間，乘客不得握持航空公司提供的服務物品，包括紙杯與塑膠杯等飲料容器。
這項政策規定將直接影響客艙服務作業，導致頭等艙等優質客艙（premium cabins）原本提供的起飛前飲料服務時間相應縮短。此外，根據過往紀錄，達美航空（Delta）等航空公司必須提早開始起飛前服務，以確保所有餐廚物品在飛機移動前完成收納。

en.title: FAA Order Prohibits Passengers Holding Beverage Cups During Pushback
en.summary: FAA mandates passengers cannot hold beverage cups during pushback, reducing premium cabin pre-departure drink time.
body: According to reporting by Simple Flying, the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) will now mandate that passengers are not permitted to hold onto provided service items, including paper and plastic cups, while the aircraft is undergoing pushback.

The enforcement of this requirement will directly impact onboard cabin operations, resulting in reduced time available for pre-departure beverage services that are typically provided in premium cabin classes. Historical records show that airlines such as Delta must initiate pre-departure cabin service earlier so that all galley items are fully stowed prior to any aircraft movement.

zh.title: 美國聯邦航空總署關注逾470架波音737 MAX機身完整性
zh.summary: FAA關注逾470架波音737 MAX機身完整性；數百架客機未來須接受特定檢查。
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）近期對超過 470 架波音 737 MAX 客機的機身結構完整性表達關注。該監管機構正針對相關客機的機身狀態維持進行評估與監督。
為確保航空器持續符合飛航安全規範，數百架波音 737 MAX 系列客機預計將在未來幾年內接受特定的專項檢查作業。
相關檢查要求將適用於受影響的波音 737 MAX 機隊，營運單位後續須依照規範時程排定檢修，以維護機身結構之安全性。

en.title: FAA Raises Concerns Over Fuselage Integrity of Over 470 Boeing 737 MAX Aircraft
en.summary: FAA voices concern over 470 Boeing 737 MAX fuselages; hundreds of aircraft require future inspections.
body: According to a report published by Simple Flying, the United States Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has raised concerns over the structural fuselage integrity of more than 470 Boeing 737 MAX aircraft.
In light of these airworthiness considerations, hundreds of Boeing 737 MAX aircraft will require specific targeted inspections in the years ahead to evaluate fuselage integrity.
The regulatory focus centers on ensuring that affected aircraft undergo necessary detailed inspection protocols to maintain high standards of safety and structural reliability.
These required maintenance actions are expected to be performed by operators over the coming years in accordance with regulatory oversight.
